assertions.assertion: Appeal of Cornerstone United's CO-97 denial
CO-97 indicates service is bundled and not separately payable
Patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness in the setting of known unspecified atrial fibrillation (I48.91)
Diagnosis code I48.91 for unspecified atrial fibrillation
Personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction (Z86.73)
Diagnosis code Z86.73 for personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction
Prolonged cardiac rhythm monitoring is indicated to evaluate for arrhythmia burden and guide anticoagulation management
CPT 93271 was a distinct, medically necessary service
Request reconsideration of the CO-97 determination
